## [0.7.7] - 2026-10-18

### Fixed

- Fade the content of every tab in, the same way: attendee page, Users & roles, Settings, Event settings, Account, events list ([#1746](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/pull/1746))
- Fit a tooltip to its longest line, so it no longer has an empty strip on its right ([#1746](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/pull/1746))

---

### Deploy
- Container image: `ghcr.io/solarssk/admitto:0.7.7` (rolling `:0.7`)
- Migrations apply **automatically on container start**. **No manual `migrate deploy`.** Back up the database yourself before upgrading (the stack no longer takes an automatic pre-migration backup).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/blob/v0.7.7/CHANGELOG.md)
